title: MemoryBackends report unsupported filter/sort as serverFail
description: crate-jmap-tasks-server/src/memory.rs query_objects rejects any non-empty filter/sort with a MemoryError, which handlers redact to serverFail. RFC 8620 §5.5 defines unsupportedFilter / unsupportedSort for exactly this. Since JMAP-yt1w.21 a backend can return BackendQueryError::Method(JmapError::unsupported_filter()/unsupported_sort()). Out of scope for yt1w.21 (behaviour preserved there); audit other MemoryBackends for the same pattern.
